posts.title: AI, Open Source, and the Long Road to TanStack Charts
posts.description: I went for a run and talked about AI, what I still love about building software, and the years of charting experience that went into TanStack Charts.

posts.title: Projecting React
posts.description: An AI-generated projection of React's public API, shaped around what a TanStack Start app needs. ~9KB client, 2–3× faster on our workloads. Powers this blog today; capable of running tanstack.com end-to-end with no known regressions. An experiment, not a product. Not going into TanStack Start. Released, but not marketed.

posts.title: The Art of Shipping: Prioritizing Product Development Amidst a Developer-Centric Landscape
posts.description: Exploring the priority of product over process in software engineering and the role of decision-making in the tech landscape.
